header.p: Can’t find what you’re looking for? Ask us directly

details.summary: Do I need to be a member to book a court?
details.p: No. Anyone can book a court on our Pay & Play rate. Members get lower hourly rates and priority booking for peak evening slots.

details.summary: Can I rent rackets and shuttles?
details.p: Yes, racket and shuttle rental is available for the whole group. Add it when you book, or ask at the front desk.
Comfortable sportswear and clean, non-marking indoor court shoes. Running shoes don’t grip well and can mark the courts.

details.summary: How do I cancel or change a booking?
details.p: Contact the front desk at least 24 hours before your slot and we’ll move or cancel it for you.

details.summary: From what age can children join?
details.p: Our Junior Academy welcomes players from age 8, with structured coaching for every stage. Get in touch and we’ll suggest the right group.

details.summary: Do you host group or corporate events?
details.p: Yes, from birthday parties to team-building tournaments. Choose “Groups” in the form above and tell us your date and group size.
